questions.cardText:
[Ecology] What are “ecosystem services”?
A. An organism’s benefits to other species in the same habitat
B. Benefits humans receive from ecosystems like clean air, water, and pollination of crops
C. Services provided to protect endangered species
Answer: B.
questions.de: Mit welchem Begriff bezeichnet die Ökologie den Nutzen, den Menschen aus Ökosystemen ziehen, etwa saubere Luft, sauberes Wasser und die Bestäubung von Nutzpflanzen?
questions.en: What term in ecology names the benefits humans receive from ecosystems, such as clean air and water and the pollination of crops?

timeline.labelEn: The UN's Millennium Ecosystem Assessment popularizes grouping ecosystem services into categories
timeline.labelDe: Das Millennium Ecosystem Assessment der UN macht die Einteilung der Ökosystemleistungen in Kategorien bekannt

questions.cardText:
[Psychology] In martial arts, display of which facial expression from the fighters before a fight can predict a higher likelihood of losing?
A. Anger B. Frowning C. Smiling
Answer: C. Recent research indicates that martial artists who smile before a fight are more likely to lose. It was theorized that smile intensity is a nonverbal sign of reduced physical dominance.
questions.de: Welcher Gesichtsausdruck von Mixed-Martial-Arts-Kämpfern beim Face-off vor dem Kampf sagt eine höhere Wahrscheinlichkeit voraus, den Kampf zu verlieren?
questions.en: Which facial expression shown by mixed martial arts fighters in the pre-fight face-off predicts a higher likelihood of losing the fight?

timeline.labelEn: Michael Kraus and Teh-Way David Chen publish “A Winning Smile?” on pre-fight smiles of UFC fighters
timeline.labelDe: Michael Kraus und Teh-Way David Chen veröffentlichen „A Winning Smile?“ über das Lächeln von UFC-Kämpfern vor dem Kampf

source.title: Smiling fighters are more likely to lose

questions.notes: Kraus & Chen 2013 (Emotion), 152 UFC fighters. The authors read the smile as an involuntary signal of submission and lack of aggression, not just reduced physical dominance as the card puts it; the link held after controlling for size.
